hero.heading: Transform Your Life with La Bella Vita
hero.subheading: Premium personal training designed to unlock the best version of you — body, mind, and spirit.

about.heading: Alessandro — Your Personal Trainer
about.body1: Alessandro is a certified personal trainer with over 10 years of experience in fitness and wellness. His philosophy blends science-backed training methods with a holistic approach to healthy living.
about.body2: Every client is a unique project. Alessandro crafts individual training plans tailored to your goals, fitness level, and lifestyle — whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, or improve overall performance.
about.body3: With La Bella Vita, you don't just get a trainer — you get a partner on the journey to your best self.

gallery.heading: Transformation Gallery
gallery.subheading: Real results from real people. Every story is unique — yours could be next.

howIWork.heading: How I Work
howIWork.subheading: A simple, transparent, and effective process that gets you results.

steps.title: First Consultation
steps.desc: A free meeting where we get to know each other, discuss your goals, and build a roadmap.

steps.title: Personalised Plan
steps.desc: I design a training and nutrition programme built specifically for you — no generic templates.

steps.title: Training & Support
steps.desc: We train together and I'm available 7 days a week for questions, motivation, and guidance.

steps.title: Progress Tracking
steps.desc: We regularly review results and adjust your plan so you keep moving forward without plateaus.

food.heading: Food Collaboration
food.body1: Training is only half the equation. Alessandro partners with nutritionists and chefs to give you a complete approach to healthy eating that is delicious, practical, and sustainable.
food.body2: Our nutrition programmes are designed to complement your training, accelerate results, and teach you how to eat well without stress or restriction.

financing.heading: La Bella Vita Financing Programme
financing.body: We believe premium training should be within reach for everyone. Our instalment payment plan lets you spread the cost of your training into convenient monthly payments with zero interest. Start your transformation today — without financial stress.
